articles.headline: Zidane set for Italy reunion with no 'regrets' about WC final headbutt
articles.description: Twenty years after being sent off in the 2006 World Cup final, Zinedine Zidane faces Italy again on Friday, this time in a suit as France's coach.

articles.headline: PSG chief Al-Khelaifi has 'zero interest' in FIFA presidency
articles.description: European soccer's search for a candidate to challenge Gianni Infantino in the FIFA presidential election will not land on clubs' leader Nasser Al-Khelaifi.

articles.headline: Pochettino labels Man City's charges as a 'period of deception'
articles.description: Pochettino labels Man City's charges as a 'period of deception'

articles.headline: U.S. Soccer's post-World Cup vibes: Lamenting a missed opportunity, embracing excitement
articles.description: The USMNT's World Cup was a paradox. Did inspiring a nation of future fans make it a success, or does the embarrassing exit mean it was a failure?

articles.headline: FIFA agrees in principle to federation payments from WC windfall
articles.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has come out in favor of a tentative proposal from UEFA and Concacaf that FIFA distributes funds to member associations as a result of record revenues from this summer's World Cup.

articles.headline: Will anyone stop Infantino? FIFA president is confident U20 World Cup cameo says otherwise
articles.description: Under fire from UEFA, Infantino is back to business as usual and inching closer to reelection as FIFA president.
